profile.headline: Software Engineer | Mentor | Process Improvement Specialist
profile.summary: Frontend-leaning full stack engineer driven to improve products from the way they’re developed to the way they’re designed for users. Motivated by working with and for others.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed team of five software engineers’ daily work across two continents, focusing on increased delivery through streamlined product requirements, empowered engineers and a team first mentality.

Supported a team of new Javascript engineers in the design and development of a greenfield service and storage layer for hardening metadata critical to MikMak's primary service offering.

Led planning, coordination and phased replacement of outdated authentication logic in favor of Auth0 authentication across two B2B platforms and authorization in supporting backend services.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Constructive Feedback · TypeScript · Web Application Development · Testing Library · Datadog · Vue.js · Git · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Prisma ORM · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Oral Communication · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer - Nordstrom Analytical Platform
positions.description: Led team development of Data Discovery Self-Service UI, enabling internal exploration of Nordstrom data for improved decision-making.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Looks
positions.description: Led design and development of Looks Curation products, enabling Nordstrom stylists and affiliated influencers to create and manage content in support of Your Look™ experience.

positions.title: Front-End Engineering Student
positions.description: Seven-month, full-time Front-End Engineering Program focused on JavaScript, test-driven development, UX/UI design, and individual and paired projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Constructive Feedback · Web Application Development · Git · Oral Communication

positions.title: Health IT Business Process Improvement Specialist
positions.description:
Helped to facilitate the effective consolidation of military healthcare through continuous process improvement and change management.

• Project Management Professional (PMP) trained
• Lean Six Sigma Black Belt trained
• Earned Value Management certified

positions.title: Project and Proposal Manager
positions.description: Led cross-functional teams in the development of federal service proposals on time and under budget.

positions.title: Operations Team, Tauber Institute for Global Operations
positions.description: Improved hospital efficiency and effectiveness through the successful implementation of various Lean Six Sigma and Quality Improvement methodologies.
